description: Validates that metrics calculation logic has been removed from opencode client and moved to rpc-api backend, enforcing architectural boundaries.

validationStrategy.approach: Static code analysis of source files
checks: Search for calculation operators (/, *, Math.) in template-metrics-client.ts
Verify reportExecution() has no dual-write pattern
Verify file sizes are reasonable for HTTP clients

testCases.description: Verify template-metrics-client.ts has no calculation operators

testCases.description: Verify reportExecution() has no dual-write pattern

expectedOutput.message: No dual-write pattern found (correct - single write path)

actualOutput.message: No dual-write pattern found (correct - single write path)

cicdIntegration.recommendation: Add to pre-push hook or CI workflow to prevent architectural boundary violations

architecturalBoundary.rule: Metrics calculations belong ONLY in rpc-api backend

architecturalBoundary.enforcement: Automated via validation harness in CI/CD pipeline
